title: How Cantrell taught and played the nightclub gigs
summary: Cantrell sometimes left the student to play his nightclub job; talk turns to Manuel Perez and players who have died.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: Can you tell me anything else that Contrell might have taught you? I mean, how did he go about it? Did he ever play with you at the lessons, or did he demonstrate the chords?

Yeah, you know what I used to do? He used to play in the nightclub, you know? Yeah. I used to be a scholar at the time at the nightclub. I'd say, I would play a piece of my play, and he'd sneak off. Oh, really? He'd play all night, but he'd come there to get the money.
Well, it was a good experience, but it was a good practice.
Mangan Parash, you know them fellas, they died.
I knew him, but I never did get the hearing.
Yeah, he was swell. He stopped playing a long time.
Yeah, a long time ago. I never did get the hearing. Did you play with him very much?

Yeah, I played with all them bands, yeah. All in all, if you need to be sure to come get them. Yeah. But Marie would work in them nightclub, you know? Yeah. Played a regular nightclub with them regular jobs.
